feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is the iteration 4 design (best raced, 53.7076, kd 0.15, ki 0, kp 1.5, base_speed 1.4, x = +/-0.03 with 16 mm footprints). Its only change is controller.line_loss from last_direction to search_right. Evidence: every design so far has gone off track on all 60 trials with one line-loss event each and max_error of about 0.060 to 0.065 m. Iteration 3 (ki 0.4, 52.8064) and iteration 4 (kd 0.15, 53.7076) both left rms_error, max_error and line-loss count essentially unchanged, so neither the fixed-bias hypothesis nor damping is the main limit. The recovery direction is the one untested variable that acts at the moment of the first loss. One caution: search_right always steers left during a loss, so it helps only if the excursions that cause the loss are mostly on the right. last_direction is the physically sensible choice in general. The test is cheap, the candidate is valid, and it differs from the best raced design by one field, so racing it is more informative than another revision. Next-race guidance: if max_error falls to 0.06 m or below, or line_loss_events falls to 0 or 1 on some seeds, keep search_right and test base_speed 1.6 for progress and completion_time. If max_error and line-loss count are unchanged, the recovery direction is not the limit, so revert to last_direction and test base_speed 1.2 to 1.3 for bend-entry speed. If the excursions get worse, the loss is one-sided in the other direction, so revert to last_direction and do the same speed test.
requested_changes: If max_error drops to 0.06 m or below, or line_loss_events falls to 0 or 1, keep controller.line_loss = search_right and test controller.base_speed = 1.6 to raise progress and completion_time.

If max_error and line_loss_events are unchanged from iteration 4 (max about 0.060 to 0.065 m, one loss per trial), set controller.line_loss back to last_direction and test controller.base_speed = 1.2 to 1.3 to see whether bend-entry speed is causing the line loss.
If max_error rises above the iteration 4 values, revert controller.line_loss to last_direction and keep kd 0.15 and ki 0, so that the only remaining change is base_speed.
